newsitem.title: GREECE: Alpha Credit Bank to raise share cap 60bln drs.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Credit Bank to raise share cap 60bln drs.

text.p: The board of directors of Greek Alpha Credit Bank will propose to the general shareholders meeting to raise the bank's equity capital via a rights issue of about 60 billion drachma, it said in a statement.

The board will also propose to the general shareholders meeting scheduled for March 27 the distribution of bonus shares from the capitalisation of reserves and the revaluation of fixed assets, it said.

Barclays de Zoete Wedd Limited has been assigned to be the lead underwriter and cooperate with the Alpha Credit Bank's group companies, Alpha Finance and Alpha brokerage, in selling 20 percent of the issue abroad, mainly to new investors, it added.
Alpha Credit Bank is Greece's largest private commercial bank.
